area.description: Choose what you do and where you work. This is how clients find you in search.

contacts.description: How clients reach you. Add at least one; they're shown on your public page.

services.description: Optional, but clear prices get more calls. Use “negotiable” when it depends on the job.

portfolio.title: Photos of your work
